Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.liquidity

Record Class KfeReserveOverviewResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.liquidity.KfeReserveOverviewResponse
Record Components:
customerLiabilitiesSats - customer obligations in satoshis, including balances owed to users
lockedLiabilitiesSats - obligations reserved or locked for in-progress operations
pendingLiabilitiesSats - obligations awaiting final settlement or reconciliation
onchainReserveAssetsSats - confirmed on-chain assets held to back customer obligations
lightningReserveAssetsSats - Lightning assets included in the reserve backing calculation
unconfirmedAssetsSats - assets not yet sufficiently confirmed for ordinary reserve coverage
encumberedAssetsSats - assets pledged, reserved, or otherwise unavailable for free coverage
equitySats - computed reserve assets less customer liabilities, in satoshis
coverageRatio - ratio of eligible reserve assets to liabilities; interpretation follows reserve policy
snapshotBlockHash - chain block hash anchoring the on-chain portion of this snapshot, when available
snapshotAt - instant when the reserve aggregation was captured
status - solvency classification such as SOLVENT, NEAR_INSOLVENT, INSOLVENT, or UNKNOWN
public record KfeReserveOverviewResponse(long customerLiabilitiesSats, long lockedLiabilitiesSats, long pendingLiabilitiesSats, long onchainReserveAssetsSats, long lightningReserveAssetsSats, long unconfirmedAssetsSats, long encumberedAssetsSats, long equitySats, double coverageRatio, String snapshotBlockHash, Instant snapshotAt, String status) extends Record
KFE reserve overview returned to administrative clients.

Reports assets and liabilities separately so callers can inspect what is owed and what backs those obligations. The derived equity and coverage ratio provide distinct views of the same snapshot; the status is calculated from the underlying reserve policy rather than a displayed total.
